requirements_or_source: Independent low-voltage rail monitor, verify hysteresis and sample gap <=20ms
Independent thermal and foreign-object hardware signal, no radio dependency
Normally-off regulated receiver rail; UVLO and inrush validation
Independent normally-off physical cuts, common-cause and weld analysis
Atomic durable monotonic per-node claim across sudden power removal, verify wear/endurance
Real authenticated service enable, never network bool
Encrypted unicast ESP-NOW peers or OpenThread transceivers, keys/provisioning
Matched coils+rectifier+TX with documented FOD/temp, offset/EMI/cost
Non-inductive resistor with appropriate voltage/thermal margins, no battery
Isolated voltage/current/temperature logger for supply drop and leakage
Replaceable positive-lock connector; comparative economics and fatigue
